This is the all-new Alpine A290!

The A290 is based on one of Mat’s favourite electric cars to date, the Renault 5. However, it’s now been turned up to 11 with more power, more aggressive looks and even some changes to the interior… The question is, can a spicy EV hot hatch really be fun? Well before we find that out let’s take a closer look at what makes up the Alpine A290

At the front you have an aggressive grille with two rally inspired DRLs that look like Call of Duty hit markers. Moving around to the side you have wide arches as well as indentations in the rear doors to mimic the air vents you got in the original Renault 5 Turbo, further increasing the aggressive looks. At the back, you have a new rear diffuser and an enhanced rear spoiler.

Being an Alpine, of course it has to have more power than the lesser Renault 5. We now have 220hp and 300nm of torque. That power goes to the front wheels alone
title: Why it’s IMPOSSIBLE to make a FUN electric car
